title: Toward Fast Human Reaction Modeling from High-Frequency Digital Interaction Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.35079v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We investigate whether limbic-like signatures of rapid, salience-driven behavior can be identified in high-resolution Counter-Strike 2 telemetry. This exploratory study introduces Ego-Knowledge, a leak-reduced reconstruction of each player's plausible perceptual state, supported by a millisecond-precision visibility engine and a reaction-centered extraction pipeline. Using a neuroscience-motivated 60--120 ms window, we derive coarse fight-or-flight labels from visibility- and damage-triggered events, with back-damage cases enabling constrained reaction-time analysis and manual label checks. We train two telemetry-native models using only information available by the trigger: EMBER (gradient boosting) and ORBIT (a custom transformer). On the full validation set, EMBER achieves 73.5% accuracy and ORBIT 71.2%, versus a 51.5% majority-class baseline, and both generalize to held-out players. The strongest LLM baseline achieves 62.7% on 1,000

translated_title: 基于高频数字交互数据的人类快速反应建模研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在《反恐精英2》（Counter-Strike 2）的高分辨率遥测数据中，能否识别出类似边缘系统特征的快速、显著性驱动的行为。这项探索性研究提出了Ego-Knowledge（自我知识）方法，这是一种减少数据泄漏的、对每个玩家合理感知状态的重构方法，并辅以毫秒级精度的可见性引擎和以反应为中心的提取流水线。利用神经科学启发的60–120毫秒时间窗口，我们从可见性和伤害触发事件中推导出粗略的“战斗或逃跑”标签，其中背后受击案例支持受限的反应时间分析和人工标签核查。我们仅使用触发时刻可获得的信息训练了两个遥测原生模型：EMBER（梯度提升）和ORBIT（自定义Transformer）。在完整验证集上，EMBER达到73.5%的准确率，ORBIT达到71.2%，而多数类基线仅为51.5%，且两个模型均能泛化到未见过的玩家。最强的LLM基线在1,000个（样本上）仅达到62.7%。
tldr: 该研究提出Ego-Knowledge感知状态重构方法及EMBER和ORBIT两个遥测原生模型，首次在《反恐精英2》毫秒级游戏数据中建模并预测人类快速“战斗或逃跑”反应，准确率显著超越传统基线与LLM基线。
en_tdlr: This study introduces Ego-Knowledge, a leak-reduced perceptual state reconstruction, along with two telemetry-native models (EMBER and ORBIT) that model and predict rapid human fight-or-flight reactions from millisecond-precision Counter-Strike 2 gameplay data, significantly outperforming both majority-class and LLM baselines.
